SELECT
-- 목표값 up.up_daily_kcal AS targetKcal, up.up_daily_carbs AS targetCarbs, up.up_daily_protein AS targetProtein, up.up_daily_fat AS targetFat, up.up_daily_natrium AS targetNatrium,
-- 현재 섭취량 IFNULL(SUM(md.md_kcal),0) AS currentKcal,
IFNULL(SUM(f.fo_carbs),0) AS currentCarbs,
IFNULL(SUM(f.fo_protein),0) AS currentProtein,
IFNULL(SUM(f.fo_fat),0) AS currentFat,
IFNULL(SUM(f.fo_natrium),0) AS currentNatrium
FROM user_privacy up
LEFT JOIN meal_log ml ON up.user_num = ml.user_num AND DATE(ml.mk_diet_date) = CURDATE()
LEFT JOIN meal_detail md ON ml.mk_num = md.mk_num
LEFT JOIN food f ON md.fo_num = f.fo_num
WHERE up.user_num = #{userNum}
